card.name: Partway through the word therapy
card.fires_on: The piece just before the ending of "therapy", mostly in all-caps boxed warnings, e.g. the T-HER in THERAPY or the OTHER in CHEMOTHERAPY. Also the word Therapies in a company name.

modes.label: Split THERAPY in caps
modes.description: The middle piece of THERAPY after a T, in all-capital warning text.

modes.label: Chemotherapy and Gene Therapies
modes.description: The therapy stem inside chemotherapy or after Gene in a company name.
modes.example: THEREFORE, IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT MITOXANTRONE BE ADMINISTERED ONLY BY PHYSICIANS EXPERIENCED IN THE CHEM<<OTHER>>APY OF THIS DISEASE.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word therapy or therapeutic.
card.plain: It fires when the word therapy is cut in pieces and the next piece should complete it.
